plan: An emperor mage who attacks from range with his sand soldiers and pushes back a whole team with his ultimate.
aSurveiller: His R (Emperor's Divide). A wall of soldiers pushes you back, often towards his team: stay behind your allies.
contrer: Stay away from his soldiers: they deal the damage.
Engage him once his E is used: he has no escape left.
Don't stand in front of him in fights: his R pushes towards his team.
forces: His R can turn a fight around.

sorts.P: Can raise a turret on a ruin.
sorts.Q: Sends his soldiers to an area.
sorts.W: Summons a soldier that attacks for him.
sorts.E: Dashes to a soldier with a shield.
sorts.R: Wall of soldiers that pushes enemies back.

momentFort: Weak early, very strong in the mid and late game.
